goal: Add a short docstring to scripts/run-node.mjs

plan.goal: Add a short docstring to scripts/run-node.mjs

steps.description: Open scripts/run-node.mjs and insert a concise top-of-file docstring immediately after the `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang. The docstring should describe: (1) this is the local dev entrypoint invoked as `node scripts/run-node.mjs <args>` (and via `npm run moltbot -- <args>`); (2) it conditionally rebuilds TypeScript to dist/ when src/ or tsconfig.json/package.json are newer than dist/.buildstamp; (3) the compiler defaults to `tsgo` but switches to `tsc` when CLAWDBOT_TS_COMPILER=tsc; (4) after building (or if up-to-date) it spawns Node on moltbot.mjs with the forwarded args using stdio inherit; (5) honors `--json` / `--output json` to suppress non-JSON output, and CLAWDBOT_FORCE_BUILD=1 to force a rebuild. Use a plain JS comment block (either `/** ... */` or contiguous `// ...` lines) styled to match the file's existing comments. Keep it to roughly 5–15 lines. Do not modify any runtime code, imports, variables, or control flow. Verify by running `node --check scripts/run-node.mjs` from the repo root and confirming exit code 0.
steps.successCriteria: scripts/run-node.mjs has a concise docstring directly after the shebang covering purpose, build-stamp behavior, compiler selection, run step, and the --json / CLAWDBOT_FORCE_BUILD flags; `node --check scripts/run-node.mjs` exits 0; no other lines in the file are changed.
constraints: Do not modify runtime behavior, control flow, imports, variables, or env-var handling
Do not reorder existing code or rename anything
Do not add new files or dependencies
Keep the docstring concise (roughly 5–15 lines) and match the file's existing comment style

plan.summary: Add a short top-of-file docstring to scripts/run-node.mjs describing its purpose as the local dev entrypoint that conditionally rebuilds TypeScript to dist/ and then runs moltbot.mjs with forwarded args. The change is comment-only and must not alter runtime behavior.
